risk_if_not_implemented: Without Unauthorized Network Services, adversaries may move laterally, exfiltrate data or reach systems that should have been isolated from untrusted networks. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
compensating_control_1.description: Automated mechanisms exist to implement Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to protect sensitive information as it is stored, transmitted and processed.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) (DCH-40) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Unauthorized Network Services (MON-21.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Monitoring For Information Disclosure
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor for evidence of unauthorized exfiltration or disclosure of non-public information.
compensating_control_2.justification: Monitoring For Information Disclosure (MON-19) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Unauthorized Network Services (MON-21.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
